name: Cheyytec Restaurant Menu Board – Food, Cafe & Coffee Shop Menu with Prices
author: laylon2021

sections.description:
Cheyytec Restaurant Menu Board is the fastest way to add a food menu with prices to any WordPress site. Create menu items with a name, description, price and photo, group them into categories like Appetizers, Main Courses or Drinks, and show the whole menu anywhere with a single shortcode.

Most restaurant menu plugins are built around online ordering and delivery. This one is not: if all you need is a clean digital menu that lists your dishes and prices, there is no cart, no checkout, no page builder and no setup wizard to get through.

Made for

  • Restaurants — a full menu grouped into starters, mains, desserts and drinks.
  • Cafes and coffee shops — a short drinks and pastry list with prices.
  • Bars and pubs — cocktail, beer and wine lists.
  • Food trucks and takeaways — a compact text-only menu that loads fast on phones.
  • Bakeries, pizzerias and small kitchens — a simple price list your customers can read on any device.

Key features

  • Menu items with title, description, price and image.
  • Categories to organise your menu into sections (starters, mains, desserts, drinks…).
  • Featured items — highlight the chef’s specials with a badge.
  • Simple shortcode — drop [cheyytec_menu] on any page or post.
  • Show one section — use [cheyytec_menu category="drinks"] to display a single category.
  • Responsive design that inherits your theme’s colours and fonts.
  • Lightweight — the stylesheet loads only on pages that use the menu.
  • Works with the block editor, classic editor, and most page builders.

Pro version

Need more? Cheyytec Restaurant Menu Board Pro adds:

  • Google rich results — Menu schema (JSON-LD) so your dishes can show up in search.
  • Allergen & dietary icons — gluten, dairy, nuts, vegan, spicy and more on each item.
  • Print-friendly menu — a “Print menu” button with a clean print/PDF layout.

Upgrade from the plugin’s admin pages.

How to use

  1. Go to Restaurant Menu → Add New and create your menu items.
  2. Set a price in the Menu Item Details box and assign one or more categories.
  3. Create a page and add the shortcode [cheyytec_menu].
  4. Publish — your menu is live.

Shortcode options

  • [cheyytec_menu] — show the full menu, grouped by category.
  • [cheyytec_menu category="desserts"] — show only one category (use the category slug).
  • [cheyytec_menu show_images="false"] — hide item photos for a compact text menu.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cheyytec-restaurant-menu-board folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Restaurant Menu in the admin sidebar to add your first items and categories.
  4. Place the [cheyytec_menu] shortcode on any page or post.
sections.faq:
Can I use it for a cafe or coffee shop menu instead of a restaurant?

Yes. The categories are just names you choose, so a coffee shop can use Espresso, Cold Brew and Pastries exactly the same way a restaurant uses Starters and Mains. It works equally well for bars, bakeries, food trucks and takeaways.

Does it add online ordering or a shopping cart?

No, and that is deliberate. This plugin displays a menu with prices — nothing else. If you need delivery, cart or checkout, a full ordering plugin will suit you better.

Where do I add menu items?

After activating the plugin you will see a new Restaurant Menu item in your admin sidebar. Click Add New to create each dish, set its price and choose a category.

How do I display the menu?

Add the shortcode [cheyytec_menu] to any page or post. It outputs the full menu grouped by category.

Can I show only one section of the menu?

Yes. Use the category slug, for example [cheyytec_menu category="drinks"].

Does it work with the block editor?

Yes. Add a Shortcode block and paste [cheyytec_menu] inside it.

Will it match my theme?

The menu uses your theme’s fonts and colours by default and is fully responsive, so it looks at home on any site.
